## LTX 2.5 Edit & VFX

Edit footage, create clean plates and masks, or generate new video and sound.

[Watch the showcase video](https://youtu.be/y5QkousNNWo)

**Custom nodes:** [Sonder Editor](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor), [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes), and [RES4LYF](https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF).

Install all three: click **Extensions** at the top right to open **Nodes Manager**, search **Sonder Editor**, **KJNodes** and **RES4LYF**, and click **Install** on each, then restart ComfyUI and refresh this page.

1. On the **Sonder Editor** node below, choose a project or **+ Create New**, then click **Open Editor**.
2. Open **Controls** at the upper left. Under **Modes**, choose a **Task** and **Sound**. Start with **Prompt Method → Standard**.
3. Expand **Start here** for the steps. **Requirements and setup** and **Models and downloads** are in the same panel.
